_metadata.summary: Defines the single owner for clinical/data concepts so downstream pipeline stages consume contracts instead of re-deriving meaning.

forbidden_recomputation: enrich must not infer active/inactive from name alone
score/export must not infer clinical row role from display labels
downstream stages must preserve this exact path and must not synthesize new raw JSON locations
enrich/taxonomy/score/export cannot reclassify row role from names or display labels
ingredient_quality_data.ingredients_scorable may only include cleaner-eligible rows except active_misfiled_in_inactive with dose evidence
downstream stages may append diagnostics but cannot replace cleaner exclusion reason for raw row role
enzyme activity and blend-total dose classification must not be rediscovered from display dose text downstream

source_data_files: raw DSLD product JSON DSLD ingredient taxonomy fields
forbidden_recomputation: DSLD category, ingredientGroup, ingredientId, forms, parent blend, nesting, and quantity variants must be carried forward from cleaner provenance
callers use normalization helpers instead of local text cleanup for clinical matching
release outputs must fail closed when current rows lack normalized keys required for matching/export
search, taxonomy, scoring, export, and Flutter consume canonical IDs; they do not infer identity from display label

the cleaner's canonical_id is an input: the enricher keeps it, refines it to a registered child, or repairs it only on recorded label evidence through identity_integrity.resolve_identity; a DSLD ingredientGroup never replaces an identity the printed label names with a different substance, species, part or preparation (docs/adr/0005-one-ingredient-identity-owner.md)

build_final_db exports the enricher's identity on detail-blob ingredients, unresolved included; the cleaner's id never refills it. The display ledger row keeps the printed identity and nests the enricher's under analysis

source_data_files: raw DSLD category and ingredientGroup fields
forbidden_recomputation: downstream stages consume canonical category instead of mapping DSLD display categories locally
legacy form_factor cannot override form_factor_canonical; softgel must not collapse to capsule in final/exported fields
taxonomy and scoring must prefer IQD scorable rows over raw active rows and must reject product-name-only omega_3 or PM-only sleep_support

source_data_files: derived from supplement_taxonomy for legacy compatibility
forbidden_recomputation: supplement_type is a mechanical compatibility projection and cannot be read for routing, scoring, confidence, or taxonomy decisions
generic Chromium must not map to Cr(VI); downstream cannot silently downgrade unknown safety coverage to safe
inactive safety may be displayed and warned, but inactive rows cannot be promoted into IQD scoring by name alone
Flutter consumes exported interaction DB severity and does not remap severity meaning

explicit pregnancy or lactation condition_rules own that target; the shared pregnancy_lactation block is only a fallback, and consumers retain the owner-authored reason, action, sources, severity and target-specific profile gate

consumers: pharmaguide-chatbot-api src/data/pipeline/interactions_verified.json (copied verbatim by scripts/sync_pipeline.js, pinned by SHA-256 in MANIFEST.json)
forbidden_recomputation: release must validate source counts, active counts, retired exclusion, severity enum, and Flutter checksum parity
the chatbot supplies exported records verbatim to its model and does not remap severity, mechanism or management; drug-class membership comes from scripts/data/drug_classes.json

Authored excluded_member_rxcuis in drug_classes.json exports as drug_class_map.excluded_drug_rxcuis_json; Flutter must not restore excluded class/ingredient membership from broader RxClass fallback. Unknown identities retain fallback.

Existing profile-gate and medication-exception vocabulary is shared by standalone medication-profile rules and authored curated pairwise rows. Pairwise profile_gate form exclusions and dose_threshold.form_scope use canonical matched forms, with unresolved allocations retained for review. Medication exceptions apply only to explicit food/procedural context with current point-of-use confirmation, never restored from storage. Label-serving totals are not confirmed actual daily exposure. Flutter compares authored criteria using shared evaluators; clinical thresholds and instructions remain pipeline-owned. New schema4 artifacts require a compatible app; older schema3 consumers reject them.
v4 scoring modules consume validated scoring inputs from scripts/scoring_input_contract.py and must not select rows from iqd.ingredients, raw activeIngredients, or display labels
get_evidence_subject_rows is the one provider of Evidence subjects; enrichment, owner selection, applicability and scoring consume that set instead of rebuilding eligibility
paired absorption-aid role is resolved once from absorption_enhancers.json during enrichment and Evidence consumes that result instead of inventing an efficacy record or a second alias table
mapped coverage denominator comes from strict scoring candidates, not iqd.total_active, raw active rows, or display rows
mapped coverage is analysis-confidence context only; it never changes product_safety_status, quality tier/status, or the legacy verdict into CAUTION
the shipped /100 score is assembled once from the six v4 pillars; export and Flutter cannot derive a second score

omega clinical purpose records own source facts only; evidence_resolver.resolve_omega_evidence_standard joins them with quality_score.json evidence_magnitudes.omega.purpose_standards, the sole owner of points and operational exposure policy
formulation, dose, evidence, transparency, verification, and safety_hygiene are the only public pillar scores; legacy A/B/C/D arithmetic cannot be substituted

Sean2026-10-22: optional-only higher-use exceedances subtract 2 public Dose points once from minimum-use adequacy, floored at zero; minimum-use exceedances retain the existing cap. An upper-limit exceedance reduces only the public Dose pillar, through the one product-level ceiling (scoring_v4.dose_safety.DoseSafetyResult.dose_ceiling, config dose_safety_ceiling) applied once after aggregation by quality_score._pillar_dose; no module subtracts for it, and safety_hygiene may explain confirmed or unresolved dose findings but cannot charge them

additive and dietary-sugar findings (formulation metadata formula_checks) are charged only by safety_hygiene within its shared budget, and a high-risk/watchlist ingredient only by its confirmed safety base; Formulation subtracts neither

Dose on every route assesses adequacy at the minimum directed daily use and safety at the maximum (Dose V4.1, Sean 2026-10-17), one Facts-panel serving when directions are absent; labeled daily use never becomes confirmed personal intake. Dose explanation.assessment projects generic_dose metadata and source-owned rda_ul_data references; public consumers never recalculate benchmark bands or deductions, and dietary reference proxies never imply universal clinical efficacy

generic_dose.nutritional_unit_credit owns the Sean-approved 20%-half/100%-full RDA/AI contribution curve used by generic, panel, B-complex and immune consumers; no route reinvents cutoffs. Prenatal critical coverage intentionally weights six fixed members including choline within the existing 5-point budget; clinical study amounts remain descriptive unless exact approved semantics authorize a curve. rda_ul_calculator.label_population_members owns label populations; SupplementEnricherV3._ul_screening_population projects adult members for catalog Dose and safety (Sean2026-10-19). Child UL assessments at rda_ul_data.child_ul_screen are informational only, use rda_ul_calculator.label_child_ul_ages/_screening_ul and the same resolved distinct exposures, and never enter score/readiness/safety_flags. ProductHealthFacts/tradeoffs_section render their source-owned population and warning; sports-reference applicability retains the full label-population selection. Consumers must not parse a second population policy.

consumer safety is scored_artifact-owned product_safety_status; consumer quality is quality_tier/quality_score_status; quality assembly must not convert a quality tier into POOR or SAFE, and catalog diffs must compare product_safety_status, not legacy verdict; legacy verdict/readiness precedence remains compatibility only, including POOR for reading old catalogs
diagnostics describe scorer decisions; downstream stages may not fabricate missing scoring_ingredients_source, fallbacks, coverage, or score_basis

Release completion stays factual: assessment_readiness retains unknown Evidence review; the publication audit may qualify it only through current manifest-bound source and canonical numerical-path proof, never by clearing holds or inventing completion.
IQD/raw/category fallbacks require explicit fallback_class/fallback_reason and fail strict release for current artifacts
score_100_equivalent, display_100, grade, safety_verdict, and supplement_type compatibility fields are projections only and cannot override the v4 score, status, structured safety, or taxonomy
scoring may consume product_scoring_evidence only from enrichment contract fields with identity/provenance gates, never from product names or inherited metadata

which canonical ids are fiber identities comes only from route_features.FIBER_CANONICALS (MATERIAL_FIBER_CANONICALS for route-defining fiber mass); fiber_digestive_helpers imports that set and no other module keeps its own canonical fiber list

the fiber text vocabularies are separate policies, each owned where it decides and none of them canonical fiber identity: route_features._FIBER_TITLE_RE (title intent) and _FIBER_DECLARATION_RE (structural blend declaration), fiber_digestive_helpers.FIBER_TERMS (fiber-module text match), fiber_digestive_dose._fiber_type_bonus and fiber_digestive_formulation._source_quality (per-pillar fiber-type tiers), supplement_taxonomy._FIBER_NAME_TOKENS (taxonomy name signal), scoring_input_contract._ROUTE_NON_PROBIOTIC_HERO_TITLE_RE (probiotic-route veto); merging any two changes routes or scores and needs a measured policy decision
fiber identity never credits probiotic prebiotic support; prebiotic_catalog.match_prebiotic owns that
scorer consumes product_scoring_class=nutrition_only and must not classify nutrition-only from product-name keywords in strict mode
build/export cannot infer clinical meaning from legacy display fields; exported manifest carries contract versions and strict gate summary
Flutter cannot remap severity, taxonomy, ingredient identity, score, or clinical safety meaning
taxonomy, scoring, export, and Flutter consume canonical IDs and identity confidence; they do not infer ingredient identity from display labels
ingredients_scorable means scoring/taxonomy inputs only; recognized and skipped IQD rows cannot be consumed as scorable fallbacks in strict release
supplement taxonomy consumes ingredient_quality_data.ingredients_scorable; fallback to ingredient_quality_data.ingredients is old-batch compatibility and rejected in strict release
score/export consume enriched safety facts and may only use resolver fallbacks as tagged clinical fail-safe diagnostics
inactive safety may feed warnings/allergens/display but cannot promote inactive rows into IQD scoring without cleaner active_misfiled_in_inactive
Flutter and export consume severity and interaction profile semantics from pipeline contracts; they do not remap severity meaning

when a target-specific pregnancy or lactation condition rule exists, enrichment emits it and suppresses the weaker shared fallback for that target; it never synthesizes an action-only reason or borrows the other life stage's applicability
fallback-derived IQD decisions must emit fallback_class and fallback_reason; strict release rejects untagged dev-only fallbacks
display and recognized_non_scorable rows may feed label fidelity/search/warnings but cannot feed scoring, supplement taxonomy, synergy, active unmapped gates, or percentile routing

IQM forms[].bio_score is the one form-quality fact; scoring reads it through generic_helpers.bio_score_of, and no pillar may re-rank form quality with premium-form counts, preferred-form name tables or bio_score dose multipliers (quality_score 1.7.0; docs/adr/0003-iqm-owns-form-quality.md)

generic_helpers.eligible_delivery_data alone qualifies separate delivery mechanisms using the existing enhanced_delivery category/source/relationships and resolved IQM form identity. Intrinsic forms, unsupported descriptors and a characteristic represented by that form cannot earn duplicate delivery credit. scored_artifact projects the same eligible delivery_data for export; consumers never restore enriched/raw delivery tiers. Sean approved this policy October 14, 2026; Verification policy and magnitudes are unchanged

whether a row is a live probiotic organism, a probiotic source header, or a fiber/prebiotic support companion is decided only by probiotic_measurements (is_probiotic_source_identity, is_probiotic_source_header, is_probiotic_support_source, has_probiotic_identity_text); no other module keeps its own probiotic name regex or category test, and a resolved IQM identity outside 'probiotics' or any other_ingredients record outranks DSLD category evidence

prebiotic identity used for probiotic support and probiotic Formulation comes only from prebiotic_catalog.match_prebiotic over the registry's prebiotics.ingredients; the fiber-supplement routing term lists (route_features, fiber_digestive_*, supplement_taxonomy) are a separate policy and must not be used to credit probiotic prebiotic support

cert_resolver.py (called by enrichment) alone matches registry rows to a product; cert_evidence.py alone decides what those rows verify: brand match, verified vs claimed programs, GMP implied by a verified cert, audited-facility GMP; scorer modules, export and the app consume its results and never re-match brands, re-read the registry, or treat a label claim as verification
Enrichment produces descriptive research-exposure correspondence in rda_ul_data; scoring and pillar facts project the same assessment without recalculating it
studied_regimens describe source-reviewed exposures and must not supply positive adequacy or safety points

verify_literature_records.verify_reference_citations produces content-bound reference_citations proof; dose_assessment.verified_reference_citations validates it for general Dose only. Empty clinical-study lists, source verification, or a neutral Dose reference never establish Evidence approval; invalidated dependencies remain held across retries

row_exposure owns daily serving and unit conversion; clinical_applicability owns the reviewed preparation, population and outcome decision; evidence_record_matches_declared_purpose projects that same decision. Unknown member amount, frequency or preparation cannot borrow a blend total or a generic trial range

concepts.owner: Pharmaguide.ai Supabase submission review RPCs / product_submission_review_target_key
forbidden_recomputation: Observed codes are private evidence, never GTINs or public lookup keys; no-code products require evidence-bound label_review/new_product_verified.
Approval/reopen/identity edits and catalog activation/search-generation changes share the identity transaction lock; revalidate complete released/pending conflicts, not paginated suggestions.
Numeric and PG_SUB association targets keep existing fields; preserve original stable product ID/lineage when a later submission supplies correction evidence.
manual_label_v2 canonical hash binds label and frozen identity; importer projects label only before public materialization.
Frozen reviewed GTIN owns normalized_upc including null; mutable parent candidates never fill a null decision. Legacy v1 numeric contracts remain valid.
Private observed codes, URLs and rationale never enter public labels; existing hash-only approval provenance remains the release audit commitment.
